notes.title: The game update ends smoothly, and the discount will start soon!
notes.content:
After experiencing some bugs, the game large-scale update has been successfully completed, the game is now more simple and easy, the operation is more smooth ~ at the same time, it also solves some anti-human logic guidance ~ we try to meet the requirements of the players!

There will be a discount at the end of this month. Don't miss it if you don't buy it~

notes.title: Game update V1.2.3
notes.content:
Updated content (version 1.2.3)
[list]
[*] two free character levels have been added
The [*] delete archive button adds a prompt confirmation box
[*] optimizes the UI display of head up and drag bar
[*] optimized the UI display of darts and balls in the game
[*] added button to hide UI
[*] added the button to click directly in the final stage of animation, so there is no need to press the space when watching repeatedly
[*] increased the amount of progress bar growth by space
[/list]
